sources.title: Text2Text Generations using HuggingFace Model - GeeksforGeeks
sources.snippet: Text2text generation is a technique in Natural Language Processing (NLP) that allows us to transform input text into a different, task-specific output. It covers any task where an input sequence is transformed into another, context-dependent output. Tasks include: Translation to convert text between languages. Summarization for condensing verbose content. Paraphrasing with different wording ...
